main_text.head: Terrigenæ (facinus miserabile!) fratres.
main_text.p: Hoc amplius, quod Sensus in Philosophorum ubique pulpitis, ceu tribunalibus quibusdam, sceleris jam pridem accersiti perfidiæque condemnati, cassâ sint apud Sapientes omnes existimatione. Jam Cartesius Rationis ille vindex & Sensuum acris infectator pessumdedit & abolevit, quidquid illis ex unanimi, quod subinde depromunt, constantique testimonio, reliquum erat apud incautos quosdam Philosophos auctoritatis: nec minus suspectum & sublestum esse decrevit, quod stabiles concordesque, quam quod vagi dissonique profiterentur.

page.notes: The catchword "Com-" is handwritten in the lower right and is a manuscript addition; it is transcribed here as the catchword as it appears on the scan. The strip of text at the far left belongs to the adjacent page and is not transcribed. Some faint show-through from the reverse side is present and is omitted.
